meta.name: Nikosh Chhaya
meta.description: Bhaduri Moshai, the renowned occultist, is drawn into a haunting mystery when an Aghori tantric surfaces around the time of the blood moon, with sinister intentions which begin to harm people he holds dear.

videos.title: Abahon
videos.overview: A ghoul from an old tale returns, hungrier for the deceased. Desperate, Amiyo and Titas turn to Bhaduri Moshai for guidance.

videos.title: Smriti Bismriti
videos.overview: Titas calls Sanjay who narrates his encounters with Genu. Bhaduri Moshai reckons a tantric's ploy to be behind it all.

videos.title: Obhishaap
videos.overview: Bhaduri Moshai uncovers Sanjay's woeful memories of his uncle Bhanu, an Aghori tantric, and his fatal rituals.

videos.title: Adot Kotha
videos.overview: Bhaduri Moshai gauges Bhanu's next move after a girl's disappearance, while an unseen menace creeps closer to him.

videos.title: Shomuho Bipod
videos.overview: As the blood moon is around the corner, Bhaduri Moshai confronts Bhanu through a ritual, but Bhanu fiercely blocks him.

videos.title: Shommukh Shomor
videos.overview: Bhaduri Moshai enters the forest to save Bonya but someone from his past stands in his way!

videos.title: Mritodeho Haantchey
videos.overview: Loknath kidnaps Mitul. Amiyo confronts Genu. Bhaduri Moshai discovers Loknath has learnt to revive the dead.

videos.title: Ektu Rokto De Maa
videos.overview: Bhaduri Moshai seeks help from child spirits to locate Mitul. In a shelter, they discover Loknath's dark ritual.

videos.title: Bhrom
videos.overview: Bhaduri Moshai is hurt in an accident as Amiyo is ambushed. Meanwhile, what deadly plan is Loknath setting in motion?

videos.title: Chinmoyee
videos.overview: Mitul is bound by a spell. Bhaduri Moshai tracks Loknath's old address, and uncovers a brutal secret.

videos.title: Noibeddyo
videos.overview: As Loknath nears his final act, Titas locates Mitul. What price will she pay for defying Bhaduri Moshai?

videos.title: Asun Gurudeb
videos.overview: The final clash of guru and disciple. What will be the outcome - who survives, and who is lost to the darkness?
